integrity: The argument uses only stated pressure, variance, genericity, and twist identities from the cited sources plus the mean value theorem. No numerical experiment or external certification is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result proves two-sided logarithmic order and eventual sign for the Beck centering, not convergence of a normalized coefficient. It applies to the symmetric half-interval discrepancy and assumes bounded type and nonzero exponential tilt.
title: Exponential local tilt forces maximal logarithmic global bias
